details.reasoning: The answer names Julie Fleeting, but additionally says Elisabetta Vignotto is tied with her. The listed ratios are not exactly tied: 116/118 is slightly higher than 107/109, so the extra claim is incorrect.
details.groundedness_reasoning: 1. The citations report Julie Fleeting among the players with the highest goals-per-match ratio. 2. Citation [1] lists her ratio as 0.98, tied with Elisabetta Vignotto; citation [2] also identifies Julie as one of the players achieving the highest ratio. 3. Thus Julie Fleeting is supported as a highest-ratio player, though the evidence indicates she is not the sole player at the top.
